about: A machine saved by the game as it was the day before the payout works (jewels merged, main at 300e31b8, storage version 6): written by that version’s own serialize, imported from a copy of main and not from this branch. Nothing in it was scripted. A machine started from seed 35 was fed three medals a second, to and fro across the field, until a ball went over the front and its roulette ran to four numbers, the last of them a fifty. It was caught a tenth of a second after the ball was let go in the top bowl of three: the fifty’s two towers still going up on the pusher with nothing under them, one of the machine’s two jewels still lying on the lower table and the other collected, medals on the rails and in the air, and spins held. `then` is what that version’s machine did in the next twelve seconds, with a generator started from `seed` and nobody feeding it: `ended` is how many sixtieths of a second later the ball dropped into its hole, `end` what the machine said of it, `jewels` what it said of jewels and when, and the rest how the machine stood after the twelve seconds.
